:::{#sol-prereq-log-floor}

The value is 6.
Since $2^6 = 64 \le 100 < 128 = 2^7$,
$\log_2 100$ is between 6 and 7.

The value is also the number of times
that 100 can be halved before reaching 1,
rounding down each time:
100, 50, 25, 12, 6, 3, 1.
That count is why logarithms come up so often in computer science,
for example as the number of steps of binary search.
To review,
read @def-logarithm and @def-floor.

:::
